thread:
nina_sales: Quick sync - Prospect 'Landfall' wants EU + Canada residency for inference and logs. Prefer hosted API but must guarantee no data leaves region (including control-plane metadata). Asking for cost delta and timeline.

jordy_engineer: Short answer: hosted can tenant-pin inference traffic to eu/ca model pools. Logs can be routed to regional log sinks. Control plane by default is global; making it region-bound for a tenant isn't standard on hosted.

liza_security: Legal will need a subprocessors roster + confirmation that audit logs and metrics for that tenant remain in-region. Also requested BYO-KMS and proof that keys never leave region.

trent_ops: Operationally we can set routing_policy to hard-pin (no fallback). Tradeoffs: availability drops if regional capacity is exhausted. We can allocate reserved capacity which mitigates that.

nina_sales: Customer insists on no cross-border under any circumstance. They're open to Dedicated or Private if hosted can't meet it. Can we provide SLA credits for availability if we do a no-fallback hosted setup?

jordy_engineer: We can offer an SLA addendum but the cost will reflect increased risk and reserved capacity. Rough estimate: hosted hard-pin +18% unit cost; Dedicated reserved reduces per-unit delta but adds commit. Private/control-plane-in-region -> engineering project (4-6 weeks) + infra fee.

liza_security: BYO-KMS on hosted: supported in our platform for certain cloud KMS providers, but control plane needs key access to perform envelope operations unless we do client-side encryption. If control plane is global, key policies must allow cross-region calls or we introduce a regional key proxy (extra infra).

jordy_engineer: Example configuration we can share with presales (one-liner style):

nina_sales: Please paste a concrete snippet I can hand to the customer. Keep it short.

jordy_engineer: Sure:

```
routing:
  type: tenant_pin
  regions: ["eu-west-1","ca-central-1"]
  fallback: "none"   # other options: nearest, global
kms:
  byo: true
  mode: "regional-proxy"  # options: direct / regional-proxy
logs:
  sink: "regional"
```

trent_ops: Ops checklist to provision hosted hard-pin:
- Create regional model pools (ETA 2-3w)
- Setup regional log sinks and retention policy
- Configure KMS proxy if needed (ETA +1w)
- Update routing policy and test failover behavior

infra-bot: TICKET-6789 created: "Landfall - provision eu/ca pinned pools + KMS proxy"

liza_security: Draft subprocessors (initial): AWS (eu-west-1), GCP (asia/europe zones for CA), Azure canada-central, Datadog EU, S3-compatible EU archival. Will send attestation doc by tomorrow.

nina_sales: Thanks. On pricing: I'll propose two options in the SOW: 1) Hosted hard-pin with ~18% usage uplift + SLA with narrower credits, 2) Dedicated reserved capacity with custom pricing (need finance numbers).

jordy_engineer: One more note - model availability: some community/open models are limited in region build artifacts due to licensing or build infra. If Landfall needs a specific model, we must verify availability in eu/ca or prepare a compatible build. I'll run region-model matrix and follow up.

trent_ops: ETA summary - hosted enable + pools: 3 weeks; KMS proxy if required: +1 week; DPA addendum & subproc list from legal: 3-5 business days.

nina_sales: Great. I'll update the deal doc with these timelines and the two pricing paths. Tagging @liza_security for DPA coordination. cc @jordy_engineer for model check. Thanks :pray:
